posts.text: Good evening sir, I enrolled in target batch during the start of the prep around july but the true value of it or I would say the true magic of it got disclosed to me today, I was solving anatomy of flowering plants question from a well reputed book but it had  lot of errors and some question were out of ncert which frustrated me, so I thought why not try the target batch questions, till now I was not solving questions from it . Then I solved the mini questions bank and the questions were good and relevant, I scored 39/40 in it, my confidence was boosted and I was in a delusion that now I know everything from this chapter and will ace it regardless of any level of questions. So I chose to do the 25 questions of neet 2025 level, that level made me cry tears of blood, honestly I got to know the real meaning of this idiom today😅. I scored 12/25 in this section and the thing which I fell in love is that no questions were out of ncert, all were relevant and have the possibility to come in the next exam. Today made me to reconsider how I read my ncert . Words won't describe how thankful I am to you for building this application, from today onwards, I will practise questions regularly from target batch and hoping to talking to you after the results.

മകന് എന്ത് സംഭവിച്ചു എന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ച് എന്തെങ്കിലും സൂചന ലഭിക്കുമെന്ന പ്രതീക്ഷയിൽ, അവളുടെ ഭർത്താവ് ബെന്നിന്റെയും സുഹൃത്ത് സാറയുടെയും എതിർപ്പുകൾ അവഗണിച്ച് അവൾ വിജനമായ ഒരു വനപ്രദേശത്തേക്ക് ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് യാത്ര തിരിക്കുന്നു. എന്നാൽ കാടിനുള്ളിൽ വെച്ച് ആരോ തന്നെ പിന്തുടരുന്നുണ്ടെന്ന് ഏവ തിരിച്ചറിയുന്നു. താമസിയാതെ, മുഖംമൂടി ധരിച്ച ഒരു അജ്ഞാതൻ അവളെ വേട്ടയാടാൻ തുടങ്ങുന്നു.
